01 / SEO and GEO

### Google vs AI search. Which option is more efficient?

Google’s list still matters, and SEO is how you get on it. GEO, generative engine optimisation, means being a source an AI trusts enough to name.

SEMORA STUDIO builds for both, and both are measured against the number you agreed to move. The figures go in your report, moved or not.

06 / Questions we get asked

### Frequently asked questions

### What is the difference between SEO and GEO?

SEO earns a place on the list of results. GEO, generative engine optimisation, earns a place inside the generated answer, as a named source. Same buyer, two doors: the second is decided by entity clarity and evidence rather than links alone.

### Can you guarantee a position in an AI answer?

No. Nobody can, and no platform sells one. What can be worked is whether you are eligible, whether a machine can resolve your name to one company, and whether there is evidence for it to cite.

### How do you measure AI search visibility?

Sixteen questions your buyer would ask, put to ChatGPT and Perplexity in clean sessions with the wording fixed in advance. Each answer scores 0 to 3: not mentioned, mentioned, cited, recommended. The total is reported monthly, misses included.

### Do you need access to our Search Console?

Yes, before anything starts. Without it we can see what your site is, but not what it earns. Analytics and the business profile follow the same rule.

### What does the first month look like?

Access first: Search Console, analytics, the business profile and whoever holds the site, in your own name. Then the baseline, written down and dated. Then the four-part audit of platform, speed, indexation and architecture, which produces the fix ledger. The keyword and question maps come out of the same month.

### Do you work with our own developer?

Yes. Technical SEO research and support is built for that: we find the faults, rank them by cost and specify the fix; your team ships it; we re-measure and close the row.

### Which platforms do you optimise for?

Five surfaces: Google’s ranked results and map pack, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and Copilot. One body of evidence serves all five; what differs is how each one reads it.

### Is this priced?

Yes, in figures, on the quotation page and the homepage. A quote is arithmetic on published numbers.

Start here

We put your name to the same sixteen questions and email you what came back. It is free. The method is published.

05 / Questions we get asked

### Frequently asked questions

### Who pays the platforms?

You do, direct. Your card sits on your own Google Ads, Meta and LinkedIn accounts and the platform bills you for the media. Our fee is separate and published, so it stays the same whether your budget goes up or down that month.

### Do we own the ad accounts?

Yes. Accounts are opened in your business name and we work inside them with access you grant and can withdraw. If the engagement ends, the campaign history, the audiences and the conversion data stay where they are.

### How much should we spend?

Enough to buy a readable month. Two or three conversions are not a signal to act on, so the first month is spent learning rather than earning. We set the figure against the value of one client, and write down what it has to return before it starts.

### Why does LinkedIn cost more than Google?

Because you are bidding for a named job title rather than a search, and everyone else who wants that title is in the same auction. LinkedIn publishes no rate card, so a click’s real cost is discovered in your first month. It earns its price when one client is worth a great deal and several people sign off the purchase.

### Can Google spend more than our daily budget?

On any given day, yes. Google publishes the rule: a campaign can spend up to twice its average daily budget on a busy day, and over a month you are never charged more than 30.4 times that daily average. We set daily budgets from the monthly number you signed off.

### Can you guarantee a cost per lead?

No. The auction price moves with your competitors, your season and your own conversion rate, and nobody controls all three. We commit to the work, the published quantities, tracking that is correct before money runs, and a report that shows the figure whether it improved or not.

### Is this priced?

Five of the six carry a figure on the quotation page. Content management is scoped with you before it is priced. A quote here is arithmetic on published numbers, and the same numbers go to everyone.

Start here

# What the monthly report looks like &mdash; SEMORA STUDIO Melbourne
URL: https://www.semora.com.au/seo-report-example
Summary: A worked specimen of the monthly SEO report: seven layers scored, two numbers rather than one, the register, and what the second reader stopped. Every figure invented.

Specimen · every figure invented

## The monthly report, opened

This is the shape of the report a client receives, filled with invented figures so you can read the structure without reading anyone’s business. Failures sit beside wins because by month three somebody decides where the next month’s hours go, and only good news gives them little to work with. The weak layers are named, with the work not yet started and the items sitting with the client.

Reporting period: month three of an engagement · Prepared by SEMORA STUDIO · Reviewed by a second reader, independent of delivery

01 / The judgement

### Seven layers, scored

Each layer scores on what can be shown. A layer scores low when the evidence is missing, even where the work is done.

Technical foundation92

Keyword system85

Content system65

Conversion tracking60

Crawling and indexing55

Entity recognition45

External authority25

The weakest layer is the one an answer engine reads first. Naming it in month three, in writing, is how it gets fixed by month six. Leaving it out costs a quarter.

02 / The score

### Two numbers, not one

Building the system and getting a commercial result from it are different things. Averaging them hides which you are paying for this month.

72/100

System build. Infrastructure, process gates, and tools a stranger could re-run to check the claim.

62/100

Result readiness. Weighted across the seven layers: how far the system is from being cited by a machine and bringing work in.

Why the second number sits lower: the citation work has not started, profile verification is outstanding, part of the site waits to be re-crawled, and this month’s visibility run has not been taken. We make no claim that things improved.

03 / The register

### Every item, and its state

Each row closes on evidence a second reader can re-run. Items waiting on you are marked.

ClosedIndexing statusConsole export reconciled against the sitemap; the arithmetic checks out.

ClosedCore Web VitalsHome page lifted from red to green; largest paint cut by two thirds.

ClosedKeyword-to-page mapOne owner page per term, primary and supporting named per cluster.

PartialBuyer question listMapped from research. Real enquiry wording fills in as enquiries arrive.

Your actionBusiness profile verificationOnly the owner can complete it.

BlockedEntity cross-checkWaiting on the item above. The site side is done.

OpenExternal citation programmeThe target list can be drafted here. Sending it is yours to authorise.

OpenFirst visibility benchmarkRuns on the locked protocol, with sessions captured by hand.

04 / The check

### What the second reader stopped

Delivery does not sign off its own work. A second reader re-runs the scripts, samples the register for honesty, and compares the log against the commit history.

The closed-item count

The headline count could not be reproduced; the register’s figures replaced it everywhere.

A published boundary statement

It breached the writing standard. Rewritten, redeployed, confirmed live the same day.

Both were fixed before the report was issued.

05 / Next

### Ordered by what moves most

# · Surface · What the buyer is asking ·

01 · First screen · Do these people operate at my level? ·

02 · The enquiry response · How fast, by whom — and did they read what I wrote? ·

03 · The proposal · Is this a document worth keeping? ·

04 · Named results · Has this worked for someone like me, with a number attached? ·

05 · Third-party evidence · Does anyone outside the firm vouch for them? ·

06 · The practitioner's track record · Has this person personally done the thing? ·

07 · Peer proof · Who else in my world already uses them? ·

08 · The fee explanation · Is the price reasoned, or is it a number? ·

09 · What happens after · Do they stay, or hand over and go? ·

10 · The physical impression · The office, the print, the room we meet in. ·

11 · Consistency across all ten · Do I get the same firm every time I look? ·

The order of work

### How long does the Proof Check take, and what do you have to do?

Two weeks, and two and a half hours of your time. You give us two things: the 90-minute working session, and your last five proposals. The 60-minute findings session closes it.

Then, in order. We score the eleven surfaces, set your baseline, read your last five proposals against the ones that won, and score the three competitors you name. If the firm actually taking your work is missing from that list, we say so. Last, the three surfaces to fix, ranked.

Why it is paid

### Why does SEMORA STUDIO charge for an audit when others give one away?

Because a free audit is a sales call, and specialists can tell. Charging makes it an engagement whose findings you can use, because we hold none of it back for a proposal at the end. It also filters for people who will act on the findings.

You keep the report whether or not you hire us.

The $1,000 is credited in full against any engagement you start within 90 days. Walk away and you still hold a scored baseline and a ranked list of what to fix.

What it is not

### What is the Proof Check not?

It measures where you stand. It does not decide your position, write your messaging or build anything; this is not an audit that hands you a strategy at the end. That work is Commercial Growth Signal and Growth Foundation Build, priced separately and published in the same detail.

It is also optional. You can start at Commercial Growth Signal instead and we set the baseline there in week one. The rule underneath all of it is no work without a baseline, because otherwise nobody can say at 120 days whether anything moved.

Book the Proof Check Next: Commercial Growth Signal →

# Commercial Growth Signal — SEMORA STUDIO Melbourne
URL: https://www.semora.com.au/signal
Summary: What you stand for, to whom, and why it is worth your fee. Four weeks, from $3,000 + GST — core scope plus optional modules.

Product 02 / The position

## Commercial Growth Signal

What you stand for, who it is for, and why it is worth your fee. Two half-days and two reviews of your time. Best entered from the audit; otherwise we set the baseline in week one.

from $3,0004 weeks · core scope + optional modules · + GST

Scope / what you receive

### What do you get with Commercial Growth Signal?

Deliverable · What it is · What it does commercially ·

The position · Statement + the argument that defends it · The written answer to “why you, at your fee” ·

The proposition & fee logic · What you sell, and the reasoning that holds the price · Read by buyers before they ask — ends the discount conversation ·

Message architecture · Promise → idea → position → elevator → service story · Everyone in the practice says the same thing ·

The audience optional · +$1,800 · Definition + two personas from your client base · Who to say it to, and what they check before buying ·

The objection playbook · Your six objections, answered in your words · Scripted for first calls and proposals ·

The competitive map optional · +$1,000 · Where you sit against named competitors — and where not to go · Stops you marketing into ground you cannot win ·

The number · One agreed metric, set from your baseline · What all following work is accountable to, in the contract ·

The handover · The written document + a 90-minute team session · Repeatable by a new hire without you in the room ·

Core scope is $3,000 fixed. The two optional modules are chosen at kickoff, not mid-engagement.

The price

### Why does Commercial Growth Signal cost $3,000?

A position is fee infrastructure. Measure the $3,000 against what an undefended one costs you in a year. Open last year's client list and total the gap between each fee you quoted and the fee you took. That is one undefended year. It opens again next year while the conversation behind those discounts stays the same. For most practices the sum is a multiple of this fee.

Six objections come up on a first call, and you answer them differently each time, because nobody wrote down the best version. The position, the fee logic and the objection playbook exist to end that discount. Check the arithmetic against your own books. That is the only claim we make for it.

What this is not

### Not a workshop with sticky notes

Hand the document to whoever starts on Monday. On day one they can repeat it correctly. Written down, or it is not a position.

# About SEMORA STUDIO — Melbourne marketing agency
URL: https://www.semora.com.au/about
Summary: SEMORA STUDIO is a Melbourne specialist growth company and marketing agency for commercial industry, owner-led and healthcare practices. Published prices.

About

## What is SEMORA STUDIO?

SEMORA STUDIO is a leading Melbourne marketing agency for commercial industry professionals, owner-led businesses and healthcare practices. Positioning, search, AI visibility and conversion systems are sold as named products, each with a published price and a number it is measured against.

01 / Who we work with

### Who does SEMORA STUDIO work with?

Three fields, one condition. Commercial industry professionals — commercial property and the advice around it: agents, asset and property owners, project management, developers and specialist consultants.

Owner-led businesses. Firms with a founder still in the room, whose buyers read everything before they call.

Healthcare and allied health practices. Multi-practitioner clinics and the wellness practices beside them. Health advertising is regulated in Australia, so each clinical claim is checked against the National Law and current Ahpra guidance, written up with what backs it, and held until you approve it. That is slower, and you keep the record to produce on request. It is not legal advice, and we say when to get some.

The shared condition: your buyers must need to see real clients and real outcomes before they commit. That rules out plenty of good businesses, and we would rather say so on the first call than three months into a retainer you are already paying for. If a good story on its own wins your market, we are the wrong firm.

Who we are not for: startups pre-revenue, and anyone competing on lowest price. Outside those three fields we take a practice only when the shared condition holds.

02 / What we publish that others do not

### Four commitments, in writing

Across 41 Melbourne and Australian firms scored in August 2026, we found none publishing all four.

C1 / Prices

### Prices and delivery times, published

No quote-on-request · the same numbers for every client · see them all →

C2 / The number

### One agreed number, on the record

Set at kickoff from your baseline · reviewed at 120 days · the enforceable clause is in legal drafting

C3 / Ownership

### You own what we build, by contract

Source files, design tokens, templates, governance — at completion

C4 / The instrument

### Our instrument is public

The eleven surfaces, free and ungated — score yourself → before you speak to us

03 / The company

### Is SEMORA STUDIO a new company?

Yes — new, and we say so. SEMORA STUDIO works from Central House Toorak, Level 3, 489 Toorak Road, Toorak VIC 3142, Melbourne, with Australian practices, and began operating in 2026. There is no decade of case studies here. We publish the thinking, the prices and our own score, zeros included.

How the work gets done: the people listed on the team page. Research and production are AI-assisted, and we say so rather than let you picture staff who are not there. A person reads the work and signs it before it goes anywhere.

How we handle claims: named, dated, sourced and caveated. A client quote carries their name and their written yes, or is labelled a sample until a real one replaces it. A claim without a source, a date or a starting number does not ship. The board is the exception: its cards print the change without the period behind it; ask and we will take you through any.

# Method — SEMORA STUDIO Melbourne
URL: https://www.semora.com.au/method
Summary: One agreed number reviewed at 120 days, everything handed over, and our own eleven-surface score published — zeros included.

Method

## Accountable to one number. In writing

A named metric in the contract, the work handed over at completion, and our own instrument applied to us in public.

### How does SEMORA STUDIO work?

01

### What is the one number SEMORA STUDIO is accountable to?

One metric from your audit baseline — win rate, fee integrity, or founder dependency — reviewed at 120 days, on the record. The full accountability clause is in legal drafting and publishes here when signed off.

02

### What do you own at the end of an engagement?

Source files, tokens, templates and the written governance model transfer at completion, by contract. Fonts are SIL OFL, so there are no seat licences to inherit. Stopping the retainer does not cost you any of it.

03

### Why hire a marketing agency that has no track record yet?

SEMORA STUDIO is new, and says so, unprompted. What substitutes for tenure: named people, this published method, published prices, and source files that transfer by contract. If we vanished tomorrow, you keep what we built.

04 / SEMORA STUDIO vs a traditional marketing agency

### We are a marketing agency. A narrow one

Plenty of agencies are excellent, and many are strategic and integrated. We are not claiming the category is broken.

The difference is shape. Narrower in who we serve. Broader in what we connect. Every price and every delivery time is already published on this site.

New. Began 2026. Four client results published, and no verified client reviews yet — we ask for those at the 120-day review. The AXIS measured result publishes 8 November 2026

If you have people who can execute but no direction, a consultant may be enough. If your strategy is settled and you only lack production capacity, a specialist agency will do. We are built for the case in between: no senior marketer in-house, and not enough capacity to run it. See the four products →

# The team — SEMORA STUDIO Melbourne
URL: https://www.semora.com.au/team
Summary: Helping our clients grow their business is our goal. Strategy, search and performance, production and client relationships keep the work moving.

The team

## “Our team’s creativity and determination make every milestone possible.”

Brent Matthys · Team Lead & Founder

01 / Meet the team

### Meet the team

Our team is made up of strategists, creative thinkers and problem-solvers, and each of them owns a discipline outright: search, performance, production or the client relationship, the way a good practice owns its own field. One discipline each. The research and production grunt work behind them is AI-assisted. We say so plainly rather than let you picture a floor of desks that does not exist. It speeds up the reading and the first drafts. Search sits with the person who reads the data, and the page gets built by the person who will answer for it. Ask who is handling your account and you will get one answer, with a person attached to it. Each piece gets read by a person. Then they put their name against it, in writing.

02 / How the work moves

### Helping our clients grow their business is our goal

We believe that strategy decides the position, and search data and performance take that position out to the right customers. Production builds what those people will see and read, and client relationships keeps the work moving week to week.

# Privacy — SEMORA STUDIO Melbourne
URL: https://www.semora.com.au/privacy
Summary: What the enquiry form collects, which four companies handle it, what our host measures, and how to have it corrected or deleted.

Privacy

## What we hold, and what we do with it

Here is where your enquiry goes, who else touches it, and how to get it back.

01 / What the form asks for

### Which fields are required?

Seven of the eight on our contact page. Your name, your practice, your email, your field, what you want built, how you found us, and what prompted the enquiry. Your phone is the optional one. The free visibility report page also asks for your website address, because the report is about that website.

Our server requires only three: your name, your email, and your message.

The page adds one line you did not type: the site that sent you and the page you landed on. It tells us which channels bring work, including arrivals from a search engine or from a link inside an assistant like ChatGPT. It is a hostname and a path. Some hostnames do identify a company, so that line is not anonymous in every case.

02 / Where the enquiry goes

### What happens after I press send?

It becomes an email in our inbox. We send you an acknowledgement as well. That second one is best effort: if it does not reach you, your enquiry still reached us.

The form writes to no customer database. An enquiry to SEMORA STUDIO is a message in a mailbox.

03 / The Quotation System

### Do you see the package I build?

No. Tick a service and the total changes on your screen. Your browser holds that selection until the browsing session ends, so a reload does not wipe it. If your browser blocks site data, it is not held at all.

Press Email Quote and your own mail program opens with the quote written out. You decide whether to send it.

Card payments run on a page Stripe hosts. Your card number goes to them. What comes back to us is the amount, the items, whether the payment cleared, and the contact details Stripe collected.

04 / Cookies and measurement

### Does this site set cookies?

Our own code sets none, so there is no banner here.

Our host runs two small scripts. They record the page, the site that referred you, your country and city, your device, browser and operating system, your network speed and the load time. The traffic one works without cookies: it hashes each request, so it can count a returning visitor within the same day without storing who they are.

05 / Who else handles it

### Which companies are involved?

Four. Resend delivers the emails. Google hosts the mailbox they land in. Stripe processes card payments. Vercel serves this website and runs the two scripts above.

Some of them store data outside Australia.

We do not sell it.

06 / Getting it back

### How do I see or delete what you hold?

Email team@semora.com.au and ask. A person here reads it, tells you what we hold, and corrects or deletes what we are free to change.

Payment records stay longer: Australian tax law generally requires a company to keep them for five years.

If our answer does not satisfy you, the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner takes privacy complaints at oaic.gov.au. Tell us first.
